faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BMC Community Development Officer (CDO) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the BMC Community Development Officer (CDO) post is 08-10-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Community Development Officer (CDO) post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is a Master's degree in Medical and Psychiatric Social Work, Master in Social Work (General), or MSW through distance education.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Community Development Officer (CDO) position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Community Development Officer (CDO) post is between 18 years and 38 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Community Development Officer (CDO) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 25,000.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the BMC Community Development Officer (CDO) recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it to the address mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the BMC Community Development Officer (CDO) post?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 870 + 18% GST for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection will be based on merit, considering educational qualifications and interview marks.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, this is a contractual job opportunity with the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC).

faq.question: Q9. Where is the BMC located?
faq.answer: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with a pincode of 400015.
